profile.name: Agent Workspace Cursor Profile
profile.description: Public-safe starter Cursor profile assets for global Playwright-oriented sync.

notes: Primary workflow: apply the global Playwright profile to ~/.cursor/agents, ~/.cursor/skills, ~/.cursor/mcp.json, and ~/.cursor/permissions.json.
User Rules remain manually managed in Cursor Settings; this profile does not write a global User Rules file.
Project rules, project MCP, project agents, .cursorignore, and AGENTS.md are never written by the global profile flow.
Secrets must be supplied via Cursor-supported environment interpolation such as ${env:VARIABLE_NAME}.
